Class GraphPetriObjModel

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.graphnet.GraphPetriObjModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GraphPetriObjModel extends Object implements Serializable
The graph-level Petri-object model: the Petri-objects a model is composed of and the links between them.

This is the structure layer of the editor and the unit of storage — a model is what gets saved to and loaded from PNML. createPetriObjModel(String) turns it into the executable PetriObjModel of the simulation engine.

Objects are addressed by their position in getObjects(), and so are the endpoints of every PetriObjLink. Removing an object therefore renumbers the links that point past it and drops the ones attached to it — see removeObject(int).
